# Agentinel UI Assets Checklist

This document details all the media assets required to build the Agentinel landing page, categorized by Images, Icons, and Videos.

## 1. Images (Generated by AI)
These images have been automatically generated to be used as base textures and aesthetic backgrounds for the site. 

1. **`noise_texture`**: A very subtle, high-quality grain texture to overlay on the site's background for a premium, matte paper feel.
2. **`cyan_grid_abstract`**: A sleek, abstract 3D wireframe with subtle cyan glows, perfect as a subtle background accent behind the features section.
3. **`glass_card_bg`**: A minimalist frosted glass aesthetic texture to use for our bento grid elements if needed.

## 2. Icons (Action Required: Download from Icons8)
Please visit [Icons8](https://icons8.com) and search for the following icons. We need them to be in a **minimal, 1px-stroke, line-art style** (such as the "iOS", "Windows 11", or "Plumpy" styles). Please ensure they are dark gray or black.

1. **Shield / Lock**: To represent security and slopsquatting protection.
2. **Database / Server Node**: To represent the 216,000+ local OSV database.
3. **Lightning Bolt / Stopwatch**: To represent the `< 1ms` instant execution speed.
4. **Refresh / Sync Arrows**: To represent the AI self-correction loop.
5. **Terminal / Code Bracket**: To represent the CLI nature of the tool.

*(Note: Once you download these, please place them in the `public/icons` folder of our Next.js project.)*

## 3. Motion Graphics / Videos (Action Required: Generate with Veo 3)
We need 3 high-quality, 10-second motion graphics. Below are the highly-detailed prompts formatted specifically for Veo 3. They are designed to fit the monochrome + cyan aesthetic perfectly.

### Video 1: The Hero Terminal (10s)
**Location:** Main Hero Banner
**Veo 3 Prompt:**
A high-end 3D motion graphic, 4K resolution, 60fps. A minimalist, sleek rectangular terminal window floating on a pristine white background with a soft, elegant drop shadow. The terminal window has no traditional OS buttons, just pure frosted glass aesthetics with dark charcoal text. Text rapidly types out "npm install malicious-pkg". Suddenly, a sleek, glowing cyan border flashes around the terminal. A crisp, modern popup slides in reading "Blocked by Agentinel". The text self-corrects to "npm install safe-pkg". The camera slowly pans and tilts around the 3D floating terminal throughout the 10 seconds. Ultra-smooth, premium tech commercial aesthetic.

### Video 2: The Data Node Network (10s)
**Location:** Bento Grid Card (Threat Database)
**Veo 3 Prompt:**
A clean, minimalist 3D animation, 4K resolution, 60fps. A stark white background. Hundreds of tiny, dark gray spherical nodes are connected by a web of thin, elegant lines. A pulse of vibrant cyan light travels rapidly through the network of lines, illuminating specific nodes as it passes. The camera slowly pushes into the network, creating a sense of massive scale and data processing. The aesthetic is extremely clean, scientific, and premium, avoiding any chaotic cyberpunk elements. Keep the contrast high with pure white negative space.

### Video 3: The Speed Dial / Latency (10s)
**Location:** Bento Grid Card (< 1ms Latency)
**Veo 3 Prompt:**
A premium, minimalist 3D motion graphic, 4K resolution, 60fps. On a pure white background, a sleek, dark charcoal circular dial or progress ring. A glowing cyan energy particle races around the ring at lightning speed, leaving a subtle light trail. In the center of the ring, crisp, modern typography quickly counts down to "< 1ms". The animation is smooth, cyclical, and conveys extreme speed and performance without being overwhelming. Soft ambient occlusion, studio lighting, hyper-realistic glass and matte metal textures on the ring.
